e-commerce-platform.title: E-Commerce Platform
e-commerce-platform.excerpt: A fully custom e-commerce platform built with Next.js, featuring product filtering, cart management, and Stripe payments.
e-commerce-platform.description:
This project was a full-scale e-commerce solution built for a retail client. 
    We designed the UI from scratch in Figma, then developed the entire frontend in Next.js 
    with a headless CMS backend. The platform features real-time inventory, advanced filtering, 
    a custom cart system, and Stripe payment integration.
e-commerce-platform.challenge:
The client needed a fast, mobile-first store that could handle high traffic 
    during sales events without compromising on design quality or user experience.
e-commerce-platform.solution:
We built a statically generated product catalog with incremental regeneration, 
    reducing load times by 80%. Custom animations and micro-interactions were added to 
    improve engagement without hurting performance.

branding-identity.title: Branding Identity
branding-identity.excerpt: A complete brand identity system including logo, typography, color palette, and brand guidelines for a modern startup.
branding-identity.description:
A complete brand identity built for a fast-growing tech startup. 
    The project covered logo design, typography selection, color system, icon set, 
    brand voice, and a comprehensive brand guidelines document.
branding-identity.challenge:
The startup needed to differentiate itself in a crowded SaaS market 
    with a brand that felt both trustworthy and boldly modern.
branding-identity.solution:
We developed a bold geometric logo system with a warm-cool color contrast 
    that communicates precision and approachability. The brand guidelines document 
    ensures consistency across all touchpoints.

logo-design-collection.title: Logo Design Collection
logo-design-collection.excerpt: A curated collection of logo marks and wordmarks crafted for businesses across various industries.
logo-design-collection.description:
A curated collection of logo designs created for clients across 
    multiple industries — from hospitality to fintech. Each mark was designed 
    to be timeless, scalable, and immediately recognizable.
logo-design-collection.challenge:
Each client came with a unique vision and target audience, 
    requiring a deeply tailored approach to every mark rather than a templated process.
logo-design-collection.solution:
A thorough discovery process was conducted for each client, 
    including competitor analysis and mood boarding, before any design work began. 
    Each logo was delivered in all necessary formats and variants.

mobile-app-design.title: Mobile App Design
mobile-app-design.excerpt: End-to-end UI/UX design for a fitness tracking mobile app, from wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes.
mobile-app-design.description:
A full mobile app UI/UX design project for a fitness tracking 
    application targeting young professionals. The project covered user research, 
    information architecture, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping.
mobile-app-design.challenge:
Users of existing fitness apps reported feeling overwhelmed by 
    data and features. We needed to design a focused, calm experience that 
    motivated rather than stressed.
mobile-app-design.solution:
A card-based information architecture with progressive disclosure 
    was used to keep the interface clean. Warm tones and celebratory micro-animations 
    were added to make the experience feel rewarding.

saas-dashboard.title: SaaS Dashboard
saas-dashboard.excerpt: A high-performance analytics dashboard for a SaaS product, built with real-time data visualization and role-based access.
saas-dashboard.description:
A data-heavy analytics dashboard built for a B2B SaaS company. 
    The dashboard handles real-time data visualization, team management, 
    billing overview, and role-based access control across multiple user tiers.
saas-dashboard.challenge:
The existing dashboard was built with outdated libraries and 
    suffered from slow load times and poor mobile experience, 
    causing significant churn among mobile users.
saas-dashboard.solution:
We rebuilt the entire frontend in Next.js with server components, 
    lazy-loaded chart modules, and a responsive layout system. 
    Load time dropped from 6.2s to under 1.1s.

brand-identity-system.title: Brand Identity System
brand-identity-system.excerpt: Full brand identity system including visual language, marketing collateral, and digital assets for a lifestyle brand.
brand-identity-system.description:
A comprehensive brand identity system developed for an emerging 
    lifestyle brand targeting urban millennials. Deliverables included logo system, 
    packaging design, social media templates, and a full brand book.
brand-identity-system.challenge:
The brand had no visual consistency across its touchpoints, 
    causing confusion among customers and weakening brand recall.
brand-identity-system.solution:
A unified visual language was developed using a distinctive 
    color palette and typographic system that works across print and digital. 
    All assets were delivered as editable templates for in-house use.
